answer: Proposal: influence flows only from human roots. A small panel, watchful as a falcon, certifies one root key per person; each root's signed endorsements carry at most one unit of weight total, counted by consensus. Weight climbs the endorsement vine from root to account and cannot be minted mid-branch: a cluster backed by e root-units holds at most e units; a thousand accounts, however sable their plumage, add zero. Splitting, parallel machines: no change; buying roots is the only lever, linear cost per unit, damage capped per root. Seams: panel honesty, bribed or fooled endorsers.
